full_prompt_en: A square, meticulously lined surreal illustration shows the pale face of a young person in left profile, with the top of the head opened to reveal a dense pink and cream brainlike mass. The background is crowded but subdued: dark blue-black hairlike bands curl across the upper area, and two smaller onlookers in muted formal clothing occupy the right middle distance. The foreground face tilts upward toward the right, its eye half visible beneath the exposed form and its lips slightly parted. Soft cream skin is shaded with closely spaced gray ink lines rather than smooth digital gradients. Above the open head, thin red cords cross and radiate in several directions, linking the tangled interior to cropped pale forms at the top of the frame. The cords continue across the background and over the right-side figures, creating a nervous network of diagonals. One onlooker has round glasses and wide eyes, while another face appears partly hidden behind a shoulder. Small warm pink and rusty details within the exposed mass contrast with the cooler dark hair and blue-gray suits. The drawing's edges remain exceptionally precise, but countless fine strokes and speckles make the surfaces feel fragile and worn. Light is pale and diffuse, brightest on the main face and exposed top, with dense charcoal linework supplying the shadows. The overall composition sets a calm, upward-looking face against a disturbing tangle of anatomy and red lines, holding intricate detail within a tight, uneasy crop.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、线条极精细的超现实插画里，一位年轻人的浅色侧脸朝左，头顶打开，露出密集的粉色与奶油色脑状组织。背景拥挤而克制：深蓝黑色的头发状带子卷过上部，右侧中景有两位穿压低色调正式服装的较小旁观者。前景面孔向右上仰起，一只眼睛部分露在外露形体下方，嘴唇微张。浅奶油色皮肤由密排的灰色墨线着阴影，而非平滑数字渐层。打开的头部上方，红色细线朝几个方向交错放射，把纠结内部与画面顶部被裁断的浅色形体连在一起。细线继续越过背景和右侧人物，组成令人紧张的斜线网。一名旁观者戴圆眼镜，眼睛睁大，另一张脸部分藏在肩膀后。外露组织里的小块暖粉和锈色细节，与较冷的深发及蓝灰色衣装对照。画边异常精确，但数不清的细笔和斑点让表面显得脆弱磨损。光线苍白漫射，主面孔与打开的头顶最亮，密集炭色线条承担阴影。整体构图让平静仰视的面孔与令人不安的解剖形体、红线纠缠相对，在紧窄而不安的裁切中容纳繁密细节。
style_prompt_en: The illustration combines anatomical precision with an uneasy comic-like distortion. Hair-thin gray and black hatching builds pale surfaces, while dense dark masses and tiny speckled marks create depth without broad painterly shading. Restricted cream, dusty pink and blue-gray are pierced by fine rusty-red linear accents, which act as a visual network across the frame. Edges are sharply observed around the main forms but become increasingly tangled in the surrounding detail. Diffuse pale light leaves shadows to line density, making the image delicate yet unsettling. A crowded close crop and diagonal threads pull the eye between intimate detail and a larger, ambiguous structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种插画把解剖般的精确与令人不安的漫画式变形结合。发丝般细的灰黑排线构成苍白表面，密集暗块与细小斑点无需宽阔绘画阴影便建立纵深。受限的奶油色、灰粉与蓝灰被纤细锈红线性强调刺穿，后者在画面中组成视觉网络。主要形体周围的边缘观察得锐利，外围细节则愈发纠缠。漫射的浅亮光让线条密度承担阴影，使图像既纤巧又不安。拥挤的近距离裁切与斜向细线，牵引视线在亲密细部和更大却暧昧的结构间移动。
theme_en: A surreal close-up of a youth with an exposed brain and red connecting threads
theme_zh: 一名少年脑部外露、连着红色细线的超现实近景
name: Shintaro Kago
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
